sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT XIII OF 1989
ACT XIII OF 1989
SINDH COOPERATIVE
HOUSING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Cooperative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th August, 1989]
No. PAS/Legis-B-10/89, dated
8-8-1989.--The Sindh Cooperative Housing Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1989
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 2nd July, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th July, 1989 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
Commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Cooperative Housing
Authority (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 27th day of June,
1988.

Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1982

ACT XIII OF 1989
ACT XIII OF 1989
SINDH COOPERATIVE
HOUSING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Cooperative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th August, 1989]
No. PAS/Legis-B-10/89, dated
8-8-1989.--The Sindh Cooperative Housing Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1989
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 2nd July, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th July, 1989 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 6 of
Sindh Ordinance V of 1982.--In the Sindh Cooperative Housing Authority
Ordinance, 1982 in section 6, after subsection (2), the following new
subsection shall be inserted:--
"(2-A)
Government shall, before taking action under subsection (2), afford an
opportunity of hearing to the society:
Provided that, if as an emergent
measure, taking of immediate action is necessary, such opportunity may be
dispensed with, but such opportunity shall be afforded to the society as soon,
thereafter, as is possible:
Provided further that in a case
where such opportunity to the society is duly afforded before the action is
taken, Government may pass such interim orders, for preventing the commission
of mischief or abuse by the society, as it may deem fit."
